sol.desc: You're shooting an outdoor interview at noon. You want a blurred background so the person stands out.
metas: Blurred background: iris at f/4.5 or wider
Natural color: white balance for sunlight
sol.pista: With the iris that wide, too much light comes in. Raise the ND filter to 1/64 before closing the iris.

estudio.desc: You are recording a podcast in a dim studio lit with warm lamps. The image should look bright and free of grain.
metas: No ND filter: light is missing here, not extra
Grain under control: ISO 1250 or lower
Natural color: white balance for lamp light
estudio.pista: First remove the ND, open the iris all the way and set the shutter to 1/60. Only then raise the ISO.

jardin.desc: A wide shot in the park. Everything, front to back, must be in focus.
metas: Everything sharp: iris at f/8 or narrower
Natural color: white balance for daylight
jardin.pista: Close the iris to f/8 and lower the ISO. If there's still too much light, use ND 1/4.

avchd.texto: Change the file format to AVCHD
avchd.ayuda: Rec/Out Set → Rec Set → File Format

simul.texto: Record to both cards at the same time
simul.ayuda: Rec/Out Set → Rec Set → Simul/Relay Rec

intmic.texto: For supporting shots, choose the internal microphone
intmic.ayuda: Audio Set → Mic Select → INT MIC

steady.texto: Turn on the stabilizer in Active mode

peaking.texto: Turn on peaking to help you focus

quemada.pregunta: The sunny interview looks almost white. What went wrong?
opciones: There was too much light and the ND filter wasn't used
quemada.explicacion: In strong sunlight, raise the ND filter. It cuts light without closing the iris or losing the blurred background.

azul.pregunta: The outdoor shot turned out all bluish. What went wrong?
opciones: White balance was set for lamp light (3200K)
The zoom was all the way in
azul.explicacion: In daylight, a 3200K balance turns everything blue. Set the balance with something white under the same light.

oscura.pregunta: In the studio podcast the image came out dark and very grainy. What went wrong?
opciones: The ISO was raised without opening the iris first
oscura.explicacion: In low light, open the iris first and set the shutter to 1/60. Raise the ISO last, and as little as possible.

borrosa.pregunta: The whole shot is blurry. What went wrong?
opciones: Focus: the ring wasn't adjusted after zooming
borrosa.explicacion: Switch to manual focus with AF/MF, turn the ring and turn on peaking to see what's sharp.

temblor.pregunta: You shot handheld while walking through the park and the image shakes. What was missing?
opciones: Turning on SteadyShot or using a tripod
temblor.explicacion: SteadyShot crops the image slightly, but it stabilizes handheld shots.

audio.audio: “…and that's why I decided to study communication…” (the interviewee's voice, in the background)
audio.pregunta: While editing the B-roll you can hear the interviewee's voice. What went wrong during recording?
opciones: MI SHOE MIC was still selected instead of INT MIC
audio.explicacion: For supporting shots, go back to Audio Set → Mic Select → INT MIC to keep ambient sound.

sd.texto: Two SD cards, formatted in the camera

lim.texto: Lens hood on and a microfiber cloth

nd.texto: ND filter set for the light

wb.texto: White balance with something white under the same light

mic.texto: INPUT on MIC and MI SHOE MIC (or INT MIC for supporting shots)
